{
  "dataset_name": "house_16h",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "log_p1_population",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed P1 population-like count to compress extreme tail and produce a near-linear scale suitable for SVM margins.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 16.0],
      "feature_family": "log_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses heavy-tailed P1 into a smooth scale that linearly separates regions of low vs high counts.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(P1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "p1_zscore_clipped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized P1 using training mean/std then clipped to robust range; provides a bounded linear feature.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "standardization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a bounded, centered numeric feature aligned with linear SVM scale assumptions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p(P1) - 7.5) / 1.8, -5.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "p15p1_deviation_from_high",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of P15p1 from its upper bound of 1.0, capturing how far from saturation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth severity score capturing distance from a natural ceiling, useful for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(1.0 - P15p1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "h10p1_deviation_from_high",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of H10p1 from 1.0; captures rarity of low values in this near-saturated feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights uncommon low values, providing a sharp linear signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(1.0 - H10p1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "p_ratio_p6p2_to_p15p1",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of P6p2 to P15p1 with small epsilon, capturing relative composition.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ratio features supply multiplicative structure that linear models can leverage as projections.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(P6p2 / (P15p1 + 0.001), 0.0, 10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "h_ratio_h2p2_to_h13p1",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of H2p2 to H13p1 capturing housing composition relative shares.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines two housing percentages into a single relative measure linear models can weight.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(H2p2 / (H13p1 + 0.001), 0.0, 10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "weighted_p_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of small P-percentage features approximating an aggregate share signal.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear combination of related percentages produces a smooth aggregate score for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "P6p2 + P11p4 + P14p9 + P15p3 + P18p2 + P27p4"
    },
    {
      "name": "weighted_h_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of housing-related percentage features.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates housing signals into one smooth axis useful for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "H2p2 + H8p2 + H18pA + H40p4"
    },
    {
      "name": "p5p1_centered",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "P5p1 centered at its training mean, providing a zero-centered linear input.",
      "value_range": [-0.3, 0.5],
      "feature_family": "centering",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Centering improves SVM margin geometry for near-normal features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "P5p1 - 0.483"
    },
    {
      "name": "p16p2_centered",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "P16p2 centered at its training mean for symmetric linear contribution.",
      "value_range": [-0.5, 0.4],
      "feature_family": "centering",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Symmetric centered values yield cleaner linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "P16p2 - 0.717"
    },
    {
      "name": "sqrt_h_diversity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Square-root transformed product-sum of H features capturing diversity in housing distribution.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "nonlinear_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Sqrt compresses range and provides a smooth continuous severity signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(H2p2 * H13p1 + H18pA * H40p4 + 0.0001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "urban_density_judgment_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment score combining P1 magnitude and housing saturation (H10p1 high, H40p4 mid-high) to approximate an urban density indicator. Computed as a smooth bounded composite.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a domain-motivated smooth severity axis that linear SVM can weight directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.4 * np.clip(np.log1p(P1) / 14.0, 0.0, 1.0) + 0.3 * H10p1 + 0.3 * H40p4, 0.0, 1.0)"
    }
  ]
}
